channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Piti de Michelle Bolsonaro é para implodir Flávio', diz aliado de Eduardo
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo claimed that Michelle Bolsonaro threw a 'tantrum' on social media to take Flávio Bolsonaro's place in the electoral race, as stated in his YouTube program. The commentator suggests the move was politically motivated to boost Michelle's candidacy at Flávio's expense.

item.title: Terremoto na Venezuela: Lula diz que conversou com Delcy Rodríguez e que vai enviar 'água, comida, remédio'
item.description: President Lula said he spoke with Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez about humanitarian aid following two powerful earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Wednesday (24), with magnitudes of 7.2 and 7.5. Brazil will send water, food, medicine, and deploy firefighters and civil defense teams. The disaster has left 188 dead, 1,520 injured, and 200 trapped under rubble, according to Venezuelan authorities.

item.title: PL aciona TSE e alega excesso de gastos em publicidade do governo Lula
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has filed a complaint with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) requesting the urgent suspension of government advertising campaigns under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging excessive spending on institutional propaganda that may constitute improper use of public resources for electoral gain. The PL argues such expenditures violate electoral law by creating unfair advantages for the ruling party ahead of the 2026 elections. The party seeks to ensure fairness in the upcoming electoral contest.

item.title: PT estuda senador Beto Faro para liderança do partido no Senado
item.description: The Workers' Party is considering Senator Beto Faro (PT-PA) to assume the party leadership in the Senate, replacing Teresa Leitão, who will become Government Leader. Faro is the favorite for the position, as he will not run for re-election in 2026, like Teresa, and his term runs until 2031. The decision will be made in a meeting of the PT Senate caucus on Tuesday, June 30, 2026, at 8:30 AM.

item.title: Após desavença, Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro podem ter encontro próximo
item.description: PL members are anxious about a potential meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro after family tensions were exposed in a video posted by the stepmother on social media. The rift has raised concerns within the party about possible damage to the political cohesion of the Bolsonaro family. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: “Só unidos venceremos”, diz líder do PL após atrito entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: PL Senate leader Carlos Portinho called for unity within the Bolsonarist camp following public tension between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president. In a post on X, he stated 'we will only win united' and emphasized an appeal for cohesion. The statement aims to ease internal divisions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Terras raras na reta final: Arnaldo Jardim vê barreira política perto do fim
item.description: Federal Deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP), rapporteur of the bill regulating rare earth exploration in Brazil, expects Senate approval within the next two weeks once tensions between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula are resolved. He announced he will not run for re-election in 2026, calling his fifth term his last, and said he will have more freedom to advance initiatives like the Rare Earth Legal Framework, PLP 100/2026 (Tariff Responsibility Law), ProFert, and PEC 34/2025 to end double taxation in the recycling sector.

item.title: Metrópoles é finalista do Prêmio Gabo de Jornalismo de 2026
item.description: The report 'A Política da Bala' by Metrópoles is a finalist in the 2026 Gabo Prize for Journalism in the Coverage category, exposing data on the lethality of São Paulo's Military Police, including killings of unarmed individuals and shots to the back. Produced by Artur Rodrigues and Renan Porto, the investigation analyzed police and judicial records over nine months, identifying a 'death squad' responsible for over 20% of homicides.

item.title: Guerra pública entre Michelle e filhos de Bolsonaro se arrasta desde 2021
item.description: The relationship between Michelle Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro's children from previous marriages has remained unstable since 2021, marked by recent public conflicts involving Flávio Bolsonaro, whom Michelle accused of humiliating and disrespecting her. These tensions, which previously included disputes with Carlos and Jair Renan Bolsonaro over family matters, social media accessibility, and surname usage, resurfaced in the context of Flávio's 2026 pre-campaign following leaked audio linking him to Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Com artilharia de Vini Jr, Real Madrid se isola como clube com mais gols na história das Copas
item.description: Vinicius Junior scored two goals in Brazil's 3-0 win over Scotland, putting Real Madrid alone at the top of the all-time World Cup goal-scoring clubs ranking with 86 goals — two ahead of Bayern Munich. The Brazilian accounted for four of Real Madrid's nine goals in this edition of the 2026 World Cup, scoring in all three group stage matches. Although he left the club to coach Brazil, Carlo Ancelotti indirectly contributed to Real Madrid's return to the top of this global ranking.

item.title: ‘Falei QUASE tudo’: o recado de Michelle após acusar Flávio de humilhação
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating her in a phone call, saying he was rude, disrespectful, and told her to stay out of party decisions because she didn't understand politics. She said she had only said 'almost everything' that needed to be said, suggesting more revelations may come. Her brother Eduardo Torres supported her, stating she had revealed 'very little' compared to the attacks she endured.

item.title: Pivô de crise entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro, André Fernandes reafirmou apoio a Ciro Gomes um dia antes de vídeo da ex-primeira-dama
item.description: André Fernandes, federal deputy and PL state president in Ceará, reaffirmed his support for Ciro Gomes one day before Michelle Bolsonaro published a video exposing her feud with Flávio Bolsonaro. Fernandes stated he would vote for Ciro Gomes despite Michelle's opposition, saying 'in Ceará, the Cearense should speak' and that the party's decision was already made. Michelle criticized the PL's support for Ciro, defending Eduardo Girão's candidacy and claiming the alliance was premature, as Ciro had harshly attacked Jair Bolsonaro and his children.

item.title: Briga com Michele pode prejudicar Flavio
item.description: The internal conflict between Michele and Flávio Bolsonaro could harm Flávio's campaign, particularly among women and evangelical voters, due to perceived machismo in the family and Michele's stronger support in that sector. This tension may weaken his candidacy before the runoff, potentially benefiting right-wing alternatives like Renan Santos, while Zema and Caiado have yet to attract dissatisfied Flávio supporters.

item.title: Michelle diz a aliados que Bolsonaro sabia do vídeo em que expôs atrito com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro reportedly told allies that former President Jair Bolsonaro had prior knowledge of the video in which she exposed her rift with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, choosing not to block its release to avoid greater family strife. According to her allies, Bolsonaro made a political and familial calculation, believing that attempting to stop the video would create a bigger problem at home, while Michelle emphasized that her political actions required his approval. The claim is disputed by members of Flávio’s campaign, who say Bolsonaro had no prior knowledge of the video.

item.title: Talvez vitória de Lula seja, no final, boa para todos
item.description: The June 2026 Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro suffering a sharp drop in voter intentions after being caught asking banker Daniel Vorcaro for large sums to finance 'Dark Horse', a biopic about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The scandal, involving alleged illegal financing, damaged his campaign and reinforced corruption narratives around the Bolsonaro family. Nevertheless, the text suggests that, paradoxically, a potential Lula victory in 2026 could bring stability beneficial to all sectors.

item.title: Michelle avisou Jair Bolsonaro de que faria vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro told her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, that she had recorded a video accusing her son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), of stabbing her in the back through social media accusations. She said she had reached her 'limit' due to attacks from allies of her sons and an interview by Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in Veja, where he claimed Lula and Jair Bolsonaro are the same. The video was released on social media on Wednesday night (24).

item.title: Nome de Bia Kicis para vice de Flávio ganha força após pesquisas internas do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) reinforced the name of Deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) as a potential vice-presidential candidate on his ticket, following favorable results in internal party polls. The suggestion was made as a political endorsement, indicating growing support for Kicis within the PL ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Divergência de estratégia não é divergência de princípios, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that 'divergence of strategy is not divergence of principles' after former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro claimed she was 'humiliated' by him over PL negotiations with Ciro Gomes in Ceará in 2025. He said he was fulfilling a mission designated by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and emphasized that Brazil must be freed from Lula and the PT. Flávio apologized if he offended Michelle, reiterating respect for her work in the party and the causes she supports.

item.title: PGR sugere aguardar inquérito para avaliar se Bolsonaro cometeu “falta grave”
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to await the conclusion of the Federal District Civil Police inquiry before assessing whether former President Jair Bolsonaro committed a 'serious offense' by possessing a firearm under house arrest. The recommendation aims to ensure the decision is based on concrete evidence, avoiding premature judicial rulings.

item.title: Desabafo de Michelle é “pedido de socorro” contra PT e candidatura de Flávio, diz Janaina
item.description: São Paulo councilwoman Janaina Paschoal described former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro's public lament as a 'cry for help' from Bolsonaro supporters who oppose another PT term and fear the country's current political trajectory. She stated that Michelle's video reflects concern over the nation's direction and backing for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy as an alternative to Lula's government. The comment was made in response to Michelle's video, in which she expressed frustration over internal criticism of her political role.

item.title: Flávio sobre Michelle: O importante é que a gente vai superar e seguir em frente juntos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released a video responding to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, who claimed she had been humiliated by him. Flávio stated that the important thing is to overcome the incident and move forward together. The video’s content was nearly identical to a statement he had issued the previous night.

item.title: Manual do Eleitor: TSE e TREs fazem ação integrada para divulgar guia para o eleitorado
item.description: The TSE and all TREs across Brazil launched an integrated action to disseminate the Voter’s Manual, aiming to make technical terms from Resolution No. 23.759/2026 accessible through simple, dynamic content on social media and official channels. The initiative seeks to expand the reach of official, public utility information to voters, ensuring clear understanding of the 2026 electoral process.

item.title: Zema nega alianças com Flávio Bolsonaro e Caiado e promete anunciar o vice na próxima semana
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for Novo, reiterated his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating he could not 'applaud someone who approached the biggest criminal banker in Brazil's history'. Zema also ruled out alliances with Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado, announcing he will reveal his running mate next week, and reaffirmed his plan to cut spending, reduce taxes, privatize assets — including 'splitting' Petrobras — and reform the judiciary, especially the Supreme Court.

item.title: TSE mantém condenação de candidato a vereador que distribuiu água com finalidade eleitoral em SE
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld the conviction of Roberto Fonseca Lima (PP), a city council candidate in Monte Alegre de Sergipe (SE) in 2020, for electoral crime. He used a water truck he owned to distribute drinking water with the intent of voter inducement during the pre-campaign, accompanied by explicit requests for votes. The ruling confirms the application of Article 334 of the Electoral Code, which prohibits the use of commercial organizations for electoral propaganda purposes.

item.title: Flávio reforça convite para reunião com Michelle após vídeo com críticas: ‘Meu coração está aberto'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated his invitation for a meeting with Michelle Bolsonaro after her public criticisms, stating his 'heart is open' and that the gathering aims to discuss solutions for Brazilian women. He acknowledged the family's difficult situation, referencing his father Jair Bolsonaro's suffering, and affirmed that his actions have the ex-president's backing, maintaining focus on defeating Lula and the PT. His tone was softened compared to prior remarks, showing willingness for dialogue amid ongoing tensions.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro decidiu gravar críticas a Flávio como desabafo após série de ataques, dizem aliados
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro decided to record videos with strong criticisms against her brother-in-law, Flávio Bolsonaro, after feeling targeted by a series of coordinated attacks and misinformation, according to allies. She stated she had grown weary of the aggression and chose to speak out as a form of emotional release. The move highlights internal tensions within the Bolsonaro family circle ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE mantém rejeição de contas partidárias e reafirma veto de dinheiro de empresas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously rejected an internal appeal by the Liberal Party against a decision upholding the rejection of its 2022 annual accounts due to irregularities exceeding 36% of total revenue. The violations included receiving funds from legal entities, improper use of the Party Fund, and failure to prove the minimum allocation of 5% of those funds to programs promoting women's political participation. Rapporteur Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira emphasized that the ban on receiving funds from legal persons by political parties is absolute, regardless of electoral or ordinary maintenance periods.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta a se manifestar sobre críticas de Michelle; veja vídeo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) again apologized to his stepmother, former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, after she released a video explaining why she had not joined his pre-campaign, citing a past argument in which he allegedly told her she 'understands nothing about politics'. In his video response, Flávio denied intending to offend her and stated he would never disrespect a woman, especially his father’s wife. The apology followed concerns from PL leadership that the family rift could damage Flávio’s appeal among female and evangelical voters.

item.title: Muita gente do agro nunca se preocupou com fábricas de fertilizantes, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula states that Brazil's agribusiness historically neglected domestic fertilizer production due to low import costs, a situation changed by the impacts of the Middle East war on global supply chains. He highlights the resumption of work on Petrobras' UFN-III plant in Três Lagoas (MS) as part of a strategy to reduce foreign dependence, given that Brazil imports about 90% of its fertilizers. Lula criticizes producers for prioritizing cheap imports, leaving the country vulnerable to external shocks that raise food prices for the poor.

item.title: Flávio adiou trégua com Michelle Bolsonaro para evitar indicações políticas da madrasta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro postponed a truce with Michelle Bolsonaro until July 25, when the PL convention will nominate him as presidential candidate, to avoid her exerting political pressure for Senate nominations, as seen in the Ceará imbroglio. His strategy of 'lying low' aims to shield him from her influence during candidate selection.

item.title: Lula inaugura fábrica de fertilizantes após 11 anos de atraso
item.description: President Lula inaugurated the UFN-III fertilizer plant in Três Lagoas (MS) after an 11-year delay, blaming the halt on Operation Lava Jato and the weakening of involved companies. The facility, backed by over R$5 billion in investment, is set to begin commercial operations in 2029 and will increase Petrobras’ share in Brazil’s nitrogen fertilizer market from 20% to 30%. Petrobras President Magda Chambriard emphasized the project’s alignment with the Novo PAC and the company’s 2026-2030 Business Plan.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro contou ‘muito pouco’ dos ataques sofridos, diz irmão
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro revealed that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro humiliated and mistreated her in a phone call, describing the incident as 'a stab wound'. Her brother, Eduardo Torres, said she had only shared 'very little' of the attacks she has endured in silence and decided to speak out after bearing the injustice no longer. Flávio apologized after the video, stating he has respect and recognition for Michelle.

item.title: França diz que Tarcísio precisa “falar com o chefe” para decidir
item.description: Márcio França, running mate for Fernando Haddad in the 2026 gubernatorial race, said Governor Tarcísio de Freitas needs to "talk to the boss" to make decisions, implying a lack of autonomy and dependence on Jair Bolsonaro. He criticized the current state administration for lacking innovation, pointing to the privatization of Sabesp and the free-flow toll system as its most notable actions, arguing this diminishes São Paulo's national political weight.

item.title: Irmão de Michelle defende divulgação de vídeo com críticas a Flávio e diz que 'covardes não têm pudor': 'Não irão parar'
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and a PL pre-candidate for district deputy, defended the video in which Michelle criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that 'cowards have no shame' and that the criticisms were 'very little compared to everything that has been happening'. He said there is no prospect of resolving the party crisis and that Michelle will continue to suffer 'cowardice' behind the scenes, despite having forgiven.

item.title: "Falou pouco", diz irmão de Michelle sobre polêmica com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, defended his sister after she published a video accusing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating her, stating she 'spoke little compared to everything' she endured. He said Michelle could no longer bear the injustice and that attacks continued after the video, labeling them 'cowardly' and suggesting a coordinated effort behind the attacks. PL party members came to Michelle's defense following the controversy.

item.title: Crusoé: Dirceu dá pitaco em disputa entre Flávio e Michelle
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu commented on the dispute between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, stating that the conflict reveals that Bolsonarism is not a national project but merely a struggle for personal interests. He criticized the lack of a national vision in the movement led by the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Fala de Lula sobre devolver celular roubado conflita com Código Penal
item.description: President Lula stated that people with stolen cellphones should not fear going to police to return them, as they will not be arrested — only to return the device. This conflicts with Article 180 of the Brazilian Penal Code, which penalizes acquiring or receiving stolen goods with detention of 1 month to 1 year or a fine, even without criminal intent. The Ministry of Justice has not clarified whether voluntary surrender will grant immunity from prosecution.

item.title: PT pretende usar vídeo de Michelle para minar voto feminino de Flávio
item.description: The PT plans to use a video posted by Michelle Bolsonaro on social media to damage Flávio Bolsonaro's image and undermine his support among female voters. The strategy involves using the footage in free electoral airtime and digital campaigns. The video’s content would be leveraged to create political wear against the PL candidate.

item.title: Libras, Estrela de Davi e honrarias: o cenário escolhido por Michelle Bolsonaro em vídeo que critica Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released a video criticizing the PL's leadership in Ceará and family disagreements, emphasizing symbols like a Libras sculpture and Star of David to reinforce her image tied to evangelical faith and deaf inclusion. Experts note the setting transcends political critique, constructing a persona at the intersection of religion and conservatism.

item.title: 'Falou pouco', diz irmão de Michelle sobre vídeo que cita Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The brother of Michelle Bolsonaro, Eduardo Torres, defended the former first lady after she accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of stabbing her in the back in a video. Torres said Michelle 'spoke little' about the incident, implying her criticism was restrained despite the seriousness of the allegation. The family defense comes amid internal tensions within the PL party between allies of Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: 'Admiro os que defendem aquilo que acreditam', diz Valdemar após crise entre Flávio e Michelle
item.description: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto commented on the rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he will speak with both personally and expressing admiration for those who defend their beliefs.

item.title: Maria do Rosário sai em defesa de Michelle Bolsonaro: 'Nenhuma mulher deve ser menosprezada'
item.description: Federal Deputy Maria do Rosário (PT-RS) defended Michelle Bolsonaro, stating that despite criticism of the Bolsonaro family's history of disrespect toward women, no woman should be disparaged. The remarks came amid debates over the PL Women's wing and the treatment of female political figures in Brazil.

item.title: Paraguai x Austrália na Copa: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Paraguay and Australia face off on Thursday, June 25, at 11:00 p.m. Brasília time, at the San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the United States, in the final match of Group D of the 2026 World Cup. Paraguay must win to advance, while Australia only needs a draw to secure second place. The match will be exclusively broadcast on CazéTV, with probable lineups released and betting odds favoring a draw.

item.title: Por que França se considera um bom nome para vice de Haddad em SP
item.description: Former minister Márcio França (PSB) arrived in São Paulo to be announced as Fernando Haddad's (PT) running mate in the state gubernatorial race. He argues his administrative experience and strong ties with São Paulo mayors make him a strong addition to the ticket, contrasting with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicans) poor rapport with local leaders. The alliance aims to bolster the PT's electoral base, even if losing in the first round, to boost Lula's 2026 presidential reelection bid.

item.title: Réveillon em Natal projeta 90% de ocupação hoteleira
item.description: Natal's New Year's Eve celebration is projected to achieve 89.7% hotel occupancy in 2026, up from 87% the previous year, reinforcing the northeastern Brazilian coast as a top domestic tourism destination. Early booking trends and the growing importance of complete experiences — driven by weather, festivities, regional cuisine, and convenience — are boosting demand for cities like Natal, Fortaleza, and Maceió, which rank among the most searched destinations in national surveys by the Ministry of Tourism and Decolar.

item.title: Haddad confirma França como vice em SP; Marina e Tebet vão disputar o Senado
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) announced Márcio França (PSB) as his running mate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race, confirming that Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (MDB) will compete for the state’s two Senate seats. The ticket alignment reflects President Lula’s preference and was facilitated by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin to unite the center-left. Francia initially resisted the vice role, favoring a gubernatorial bid, but relented under political pressure, while Tebet and Silva were advised to pursue Senate seats due to their higher electoral viability.

item.title: Após reunião com Lula, França aceita ser vice de Haddad em São Paulo
item.description: Former Entrepreneurship Minister Márcio França (PSB) will be the running mate of Fernando Haddad (PT) in the São Paulo gubernatorial race, following a meeting led by President Lula at the Palácio da Alvorada. The agreement, which also names Simone Tebet (PSB) and Marina Silva (Rede) as Senate candidates, aims to consolidate Lula's electoral base in Brazil's largest college of voters, despite the left's isolation in the state and Tarcísio de Freitas's (Republicans) strong polling lead.

item.title: Valdemar se coloca como 'bombeiro' de crise entre Michelle e Flávio e diz que vai conversar com os dois para resolver divergências
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, announced he will personally mediate the crisis between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro after she accused him of disrespect and he denied intending to offend. The disagreement stems from the PL's stance on the Ceará gubernatorial race: Flávio and the party leadership support Ciro Gomes (PSDB), while Michelle opposes it. Valdemar stressed that the party remains focused on defeating the current government and that internal differences are natural in a democratic environment.

item.title: Nova Serra das Araras abre para veículos nesta quinta; veja a data da próxima abertura a motoristas
item.description: The Nova Serra das Araras opened a 3.6 km section of the uphill lane toward São Paulo on Thursday (25), two days after its inauguration attended by President Lula, acting Governor Ricardo Couto, and Transport Minister George Santoro. The project, part of the BR-116 modernization, features four lanes, LED lighting, eight new viaducts, and the elimination of seven dangerous curves between Piraí and Paracambi. Full completion is expected by March 2027, with the next phase in August involving four new viaducts on the downhill lane.

item.title: Maria do Rosário sai em defesa de Michelle Bolsonaro: ‘Nenhuma mulher deve ser menosprezada’
item.description: Federal deputy Maria do Rosário (PT-RS) defended Michelle Bolsonaro after allegations of humiliation by Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that no woman should be belittled, despite criticizing the Bolsonaro family's history of disrespect toward women. She urged Michelle to file a police report for alleged oppression by her stepson and emphasized that feminist solidarity demands justice for all women, regardless of political affiliation. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied the allegations, claiming he has never disrespected a woman and apologizing if he offended Michelle.
